slides.title: The nurse has taught a client who has hypertension and a body mass index of 28.
text: Question: The nurse has taught a client who has hypertension and a body mass index of 28. Which of the following statements by the client would indicate a correct understanding of the teaching?
A. “I should limit my sodium intake to 3300 mg per day.”
B. “I will participate in a maximum of 1 hour of exercise per week.”
C. “I can drink the maximum of 3 beverages that contain alcohol per day.”
D. “I am going to eat less calories per day by following the Mediterranean diet.”
Correct answer: D. “I am going to eat less calories per day by following the Mediterranean diet.”
notes: Correct: A lower-calorie heart-healthy eating pattern such as the Mediterranean diet supports weight loss, which lowers blood pressure.
• Sodium should be limited to about 2 g a day, not 3300 mg (class slide 5).
• Aerobic exercise should be increased; 1 hour a week is too little.
• Alcohol should be limited; 3 drinks a day is too many.
(Answer key not on the slide; worked out with NCLEX reasoning, so check it against your class notes.)
